# ADR 0002: Ordered matching passes, set-based first

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Settlement reconciliation engine

## Context

Most items match exactly; the rest need fuzzier rules that are expensive.

## Decision

Run an exact FULL OUTER JOIN in SQL first, then normalised-reference, tolerance and date-window passes only on what remains.

## Consequences

Fast and explainable (each match records its pass).

## Alternatives considered

One fuzzy pass over everything.
